powershell_defensive_soc.description: Extended defensive PowerShell techniques for SOC analysts — advanced triage, persistence detection, lateral movement detection, credential abuse monitoring, and forensic collection.

commands.description: List processes with high CPU usage (potential crypto miner or runaway process).
Detect encoded PowerShell command executions in event logs.
Identify processes spawned by Office applications (macro abuse detection).
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ParentProcessId -in (Get-Process winword,excel,powerpnt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Id } | Select Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId

commands.description: Check for suspicious WMI event subscriptions (persistence).
List WMI consumers (malicious persistence detection).
Check for suspicious DLLs loaded by running processes.
Identify unsigned drivers loaded on the system.
List Active Directory group memberships for current user.
Check Kerberos ticket cache (possible ticket abuse).
List local cached credentials.
Identify RDP sessions on system.
Check recent account lockouts.
Detect password spraying attempts (multiple 4625 failures across accounts).
Check for abnormal admin group changes.
Identify newly created local accounts.
Detect suspicious PowerShell execution policy changes.
Check for enabled PowerShell transcription logging.
List environment variables (check for malicious modifications).
Check for hidden files in user directories.
Detect alternate data streams (ADS).
List active WinRM listeners.
Check system for persistence via RunOnce registry key.
Identify suspicious outbound connections to public IPs.
Collect full process, service, and network triage into a single report file.
Export all event logs for forensic preservation.
Detect logon using explicit credentials — RunAs, Pass-the-Hash, or OverPtH (Event 4648).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4648} | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Subject';E={($_.Message -split 'Subject:\s+Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='TargetAcct';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Whose Credentials Were Used:\s+Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect special privileges (SeDebugPrivilege, SeTcbPrivilege) assigned at logon (Event 4672).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4672} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(SeDebugPrivilege|SeTcbPrivilege|SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege|SeBackupPrivilege)' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect NTLM credential validation failures — brute force or bad password (Event 4776).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4776} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Error Code:\s+0xC000006D' } | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Workstation Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10 Name,Count

commands.description: Detect Kerberoasting — RC4 TGS-REQ for service accounts (Event 4769, EncType 0x17).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4769} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '0x17' -and $_.Message -notmatch 'Service Name:\s+\S+\$' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Service';E={($_.Message -split 'Service Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect AS-REP roasting — Kerberos pre-auth failure, FailureCode 0x18 (Event 4771).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4771} | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Client Address:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10 Name,Count

commands.description: Detect user account deletions (Event 4726) — possible cover-up post-compromise.
Detect user account changes — password flags, delegation enabled, UAC modification (Event 4738).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4738} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(DONT_REQ_PREAUTH|TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION|PASSWORD_NOT_REQUIRED)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Target Account:\s+Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect RDP session reconnect — possible session hijack (Event 4778).
Detect admin share access (ADMIN$/C$/IPC$) from unexpected clients (Event 5145).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=5145} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(ADMIN\$|C\$|IPC\$)' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|ANONYMOUS)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Share';E={($_.Message -split 'Share Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Source';E={($_.Message -split 'Source Address:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}} | Select -First 20

commands.description: Check last reboot time — used to verify attacker persistence across reboots (Event 6005).
commands.command:
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=6005} -MaxEvents 5 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Event 6006 = clean shutdown:
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=6006} -MaxEvents 5 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: System event log cleared (Event 104 in System log — complements Security 1102).

av_edr_bypass_defensive.description: Extended defensive detection and monitoring techniques for attempts to disable, tamper with, or bypass AV and EDR products (MITRE T1562 – Impair Defenses). Designed for SOC detection engineering, threat hunting, and incident response.

commands.description: Detect Windows Defender real-time protection being disabled.
Check current Defender protection status.
Monitor Defender exclusion additions (paths, processes, extensions).
Detect registry-based Defender tampering.
Detect changes to Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules.
Detect service stop events for AV/EDR services (Event ID 7036).
Detect new driver service installations (Event ID 7045).
List recently loaded kernel drivers (possible BYOVD activity).
Monitor ETW provider disablement attempts.
Detect event log clearing (Security Event ID 1102).
Detect audit policy changes (Event ID 4719).
Check for changes in Windows Firewall state.
Detect firewall rule modifications.
Detect suspicious modification to hosts file.
Identify suspicious use of taskkill against security agents.
Detect suspicious process access (possible EDR tampering) using Event ID 4656.
Check for PowerShell downgrade attacks (Engine version check).
Detect suspicious PowerShell execution policy changes.
Check for disabling of PowerShell logging policies.
Detect Defender Tamper Protection status.
Detect modifications to Windows Security Center service.
Identify changes to startup type of security-related services.
Detect suspicious DLL unhooking attempts via loaded module comparison (baseline required).
Identify abnormal driver load times (recent driver files written).
Detect suspicious scheduled task creation (Event ID 4698).
Detect attempts to disable Windows Defender via registry (DisableAntiSpyware key).
Monitor for abnormal removal of security software from installed programs list.

av_edr_bypass_defensive.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary PowerShell data sources for context.

credential_dumping_defensive.description: Detect LSASS access, SAM hive exports, and credential extraction activity on Windows.

commands.description: Check for LSASS dump files on disk (procdump or comsvcs output).
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Recurse -Filter '*.dmp' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'lsass' } | Select FullName,LastWriteTime

commands.description: Look for reg.exe SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hive export events in Security log.
Detect rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump (LSASS dump via LOLBin).
Detect procdump targeting lsass.exe.
Check Sysmon Event 10 (ProcessAccess) for LSASS handle opens by suspicious processes.
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath "*[System[EventID=10] and EventData[Data[@Name='TargetImage'] and (Data='C:\Windows\system32\lsass.exe')]]" | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(MsMpEng|csrss|winlogon|lsm)' } | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: Check if Mimikatz keywords appear in PowerShell Script Block logs.
List recent .dmp files anywhere on the system (fast scan for dump artifacts).
commands.command: Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP,$env:APPDATA,'C:\Windows\Temp','C:\Users' -Recurse -Filter '*.dmp' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending

commands.description: Detect CreateRemoteThread injected into LSASS — process injection for credential dump (Sysmon Event 8).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath "*[System[EventID=8] and EventData[Data[@Name='TargetImage'] and (Data='C:\Windows\system32\lsass.exe')]]" | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(MsMpEng|csrss|werfault)' } | Select TimeCreated,Message | Select -First 10

commands.description: Detect SeDebugPrivilege use — required by Mimikatz and most LSASS dumpers (Event 4673).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4673} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'SeDebugPrivilege' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

credential_dumping_defensive.tuning: Alert on LSASS/SAM access from non-system processes. Whitelist backup agents and EDR sensors. Correlate credential access with subsequent unusual auth activity in PowerShell.

lateral_movement_defensive.description: Detect lateral movement via PSExec, WMI, WinRM, RDP, and scheduled tasks.

commands.description: Detect PSExec service installation (Event 7045 PSEXESVC).
Detect WmiPrvSE.exe spawning cmd/PowerShell (WMI lateral exec).
Check for WinRM remote sessions (EventID 4624 LogonType 3 via wsmprovhost).
Detect RDP brute force — many failed Type-10 logons from same IP.
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4625} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Logon Type:\s+10' } | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Source Network Address:')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10

commands.description: Check for schtasks remote task creation.
Detect DCOM lateral movement — MMC spawning cmd/PowerShell.
Detect admin share writes via SMB — file drop for lateral movement (Event 5145, AccessMask 0x2).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=5145} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Accesses:\s+WriteData' -or $_.Message -match 'AccessMask:\s+0x2' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Account';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Share';E={($_.Message -split 'Share Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Source';E={($_.Message -split 'Source Address:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}} | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect explicit credential logon from non-standard context — over-PtH, RunAs for lateral move (Event 4648).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4648} | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE|DWM|UMFD)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Actor';E={($_.Message -split 'Subject:\s+Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='Target';E={($_.Message -split 'Account Whose Credentials Were Used:\s+Account Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

lateral_movement_defensive.tuning: Baseline normal admin movement patterns in your environment before enabling alerting. Exclude DC replication traffic. Alert on first-seen lateral paths between host pairs.

persistence_detection_defensive.description: Detect Windows persistence — scheduled tasks, registry run keys, WMI subscriptions, services, and DLL hijacks.

commands.description: List all scheduled tasks and filter for non-Microsoft origins.
Check registry Run and RunOnce keys for all users.
Enumerate all WMI permanent event subscriptions (persistence via WMI).
commands.command: Get-WMIObject -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventFilter; Get-WMIObject -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventConsumer; Get-WMIObject -Namespace root\subscription -Class __FilterToConsumerBinding

commands.description: Check startup folder for all users.
List recently installed Windows services (possible backdoor service).
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.PathName -notmatch '(System32|SysWOW64|Program Files)' } | Select Name,State,StartMode,PathName

commands.description: Detect AppInit_DLLs set (malicious DLL auto-load on any GUI app).
Check for COM hijacking via HKCU CLSID overrides.
Detect new service installed via Security log — complements System Event 7045 (Event 4697).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4697} | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(System32|SysWOW64|Program Files|MsMpEng|WinDefend)' } | Select TimeCreated,@{N='ServiceName';E={($_.Message -split 'Service Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},@{N='ServiceFile';E={($_.Message -split 'Service File Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect scheduled task enabled or modified (Events 4700 and 4702) — post-install enable of disabled malicious task.
commands.command:
# Task enabled:
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4700} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Task';E={($_.Message -split 'Task Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message
# Task modified:
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4702} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,@{N='Task';E={($_.Message -split 'Task Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()}},Message

commands.description: Query Task Scheduler operational log for task registrations, deletions, and executions (Events 106 / 141 / 200).
Detect WMI permanent event subscription created — stealthy fileless persistence (WMI-Activity Event 5861).

persistence_detection_defensive.tuning: Alert on persistence outside business hours or from unusual accounts. Whitelist software deployment mechanisms. Cross-reference with PowerShell change management records.

ransomware_indicators_defensive.description: Detect ransomware precursor and execution activity — shadow copy deletion, backup destruction, mass encryption.

commands.description: Detect vssadmin or wmic shadow copy deletion.
Check current VSS shadow copies (verify none deleted).
Detect bcdedit disabling boot recovery.
Check for ransom note filenames in common directories.
Check for mass file rename activity (encryption indicator) in Sysmon log.
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=2]]' -MaxEvents 200 | Group-Object {$_.Message -split 'Image: ' | Select -Index 1 | Split-Path -Leaf} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10

commands.description: Look for bulk file extension changes (unusual extension appended — ransomware signature).
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Extension -match '\.[a-z0-9]{5,15}$' -and $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddHours(-1) } | Group-Object Extension | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 5

ransomware_indicators_defensive.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary PowerShell data sources for context.

network_hunting_defensive.description: Hunt for suspicious network connections, C2 beacons, DNS exfiltration, and tunneling.

commands.description: List all established outbound connections to non-private IPs.
commands.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Where-Object { $_.RemoteAddress -notmatch '^(10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|192\.168\.|127\.|::1|0\.0)' } | Select LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,@{N='Process';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Name}} | Sort-Object RemoteAddress

commands.description: Find processes with unusual listening ports.
Detect DNS exfiltration — nslookup or Resolve-DnsName called frequently.
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4688} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'nslookup.exe' } | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Account Name:')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10

commands.description: Check for suspicious proxy or tunnel processes running.
Check netsh portproxy rules (used for port forwarding persistence).
Detect high DNS query volume — possible beaconing or DNS exfiltration (requires Sysmon DNS logging).
Hunt Sysmon network connections — detect C2 on non-standard ports (Sysmon Event 3).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=3]]' -MaxEvents 500 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'DestinationPort: (4444|1337|8443|4443|8080|9090|2222|31337|443[^0]|8888)' -or ($_.Message -match 'Initiated: true' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(svchost|chrome|firefox|teams|edge)') } | Select TimeCreated,Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect Windows Filtering Platform connection events — inbound to unusual processes (Event 5156).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=5156} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Direction:\s+%%14593' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(svchost|lsass|System|MsMpEng|SearchIndexer)' } | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Application Name:\s+')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select -First 10

commands.description: Detect loaded kernel driver from user-writable path — BYOVD indicator (Sysmon Event 6).
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=6]]' -MaxEvents 100 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'ImageLoaded:.*?(Users|Temp|AppData|Downloads|ProgramData)' -or $_.Message -match 'Signed: false' } | Select TimeCreated,Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: Detect process tampering (hollowing, unmapping, APC injection) — Sysmon Event 25.

network_hunting_defensive.tuning: Tune on internal traffic anomalies. Whitelist known scanners, monitoring agents, and backup systems. Alert on internal scanning from endpoints (not servers) as high priority.

windows_event_id_quick_reference.description: Quick-reference PowerShell commands for every critical Windows Security and Sysmon Event ID. Use as a SOC analyst cheat sheet — run any command to pull relevant events for triage.

commands.description: ACCOUNT LOGON — 4624 (Logon Success) | 4625 (Logon Failure) | 4634/4647 (Logoff) | 4648 (Explicit Creds) | 4672 (Special Privileges)
commands.command:
# Logon success (filter by type): 4624
# LogonType 2=Interactive, 3=Network, 4=Batch, 5=Service, 7=Unlock, 10=RemoteInteractive(RDP), 11=CachedInteractive
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4624} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Logon Type:\s+(10|3)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Logon failure (pass spray): 4625 | Error codes: 0xC000006D=bad pw, 0xC0000234=locked, 0xC000006F=outside hours
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4625} | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Explicit credential: 4648
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4648} | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Special privileges at logon: 4672 | Look for SeDebugPrivilege, SeTcbPrivilege, SeImpersonatePrivilege
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4672} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'SeDebugPrivilege' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT — 4720 (Create) | 4726 (Delete) | 4738 (Change) | 4740 (Lockout) | 4767 (Unlock) | 4728/4732/4756 (Group Add) | 4729/4733/4757 (Group Remove)
commands.command:
# User created: 4720
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4720} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# User deleted: 4726
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4726} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# User account changed (password flags, delegation): 4738
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4738} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# User locked out: 4740
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4740} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Added to Domain Admins (4728) / Administrators local (4732) / Enterprise Admins (4756):
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4728} -MaxEvents 5 | Select TimeCreated,Message
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4732} -MaxEvents 5 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: KERBEROS — 4768 (TGT/AS-REQ) | 4769 (TGS-REQ — Kerberoasting if RC4) | 4770 (TGS Renew) | 4771 (Pre-Auth Fail — AS-REP Roasting) | 4776 (NTLM Validate)
commands.command:
# Kerberoasting: Event 4769 with EncType 0x17 (RC4)
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4769} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '0x17' -and $_.Message -notmatch '\$' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# AS-REP Roasting: Event 4771 pre-auth failures
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4771} | Group-Object {($_.Message -split 'Client Address:')[1].Split([char]10)[0].Trim()} | Sort-Object Count -Desc | Select -First 5
# NTLM auth: 4776 | Error 0xC000006D = wrong password
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4776} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: PROCESS & PRIVILEGE — 4688 (Process Create) | 4689 (Process Exit) | 4673 (Sensitive Priv Use) | 4674 (Priv Op on Object) | 4697 (Service Install Security) | 4698/4702 (Sched Task Create/Modify)
commands.command:
# Process create with command line (requires audit policy + 4688 cmdline logging):
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4688} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(powershell|cmd|wscript|cscript|mshta|certutil)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# SeDebugPrivilege use: 4673
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4673} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'SeDebugPrivilege' -and $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|LOCAL)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Service installed (Security log): 4697
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4697} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Scheduled task created: 4698
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4698} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Scheduled task modified: 4702
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4702} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: OBJECT ACCESS & SHARES — 5140 (Share Accessed) | 5145 (Share Access Check) | 4663 (File Object Access) | 4656 (Handle Request) | 4657 (Registry Modified)
commands.command:
# Network share accessed: 5140
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=5140} | Where-Object { $_.Message -notmatch '(SYSTEM|ANONYMOUS)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Share detailed access check: 5145 | Key for SMB lateral movement detection
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=5145} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(ADMIN\$|C\$)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Registry value modified: 4657 | Requires audit policy on specific keys
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4657} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Object access (files/keys): 4663 | Requires SACL on object
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4663} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: POLICY & LOG — 4719 (Audit Policy Change) | 1102 (Security Log Cleared) | 4609 (Event System Shutdown) | 4616 (System Time Changed) | 4906 (CrashOnAuditFail) | System 104 (Log Cleared) | 6005/6006 (Svc Start/Stop)
commands.command:
# Audit policy change: 4719
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4719} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Security log cleared: 1102
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=1102} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# System log cleared: 104
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=104} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# System time changed (forensic anti-analysis): 4616
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4616} -MaxEvents 5 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Last reboot: 6005
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=6005} -MaxEvents 3 | Select TimeCreated

commands.description: SYSMON EVENT ID MAP — 1:ProcCreate 2:FileTimeChange 3:NetConn 6:DriverLoad 7:ImageLoad 8:CreateRemoteThread 10:ProcAccess 11:FileCreate 12-14:Registry 15:ADS 17-18:NamedPipe 19-21:WMI 22:DNSQuery 25:ProcTamper
commands.command:
# Sysmon Event 1 — Process Create (richer than 4688):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=1]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(cmd|powershell|wscript|mshta)' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 3 — Network Connection:
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=3]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'DestinationPort: (4444|8443|4443|1337|31337)' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 6 — Driver Load (BYOVD):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=6]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Signed: false' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 7 — Image Load (DLL injection):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=7]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(Users|Temp|AppData)' -and $_.Message -match 'Signed: false' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 8 — CreateRemoteThread:
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=8]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 10 — Process Access (LSASS dump):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=10]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'lsass' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 11 — File Create:
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=11]]' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(Temp|AppData|Downloads).*\.exe' } | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Sysmon Event 25 — Process Tampering (hollowing):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=25]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: SYSTEM EVENTS — 7045 (Service Install) | 7036 (Service State) | 7040 (StartType Change) | 6005/6006 (Svc Start/Stop=Boot/Shutdown) | Task Scheduler 106/141/200/201
commands.command:
# New service installed (System log): 7045
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=7045} | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Service state changed: 7036 | Filter for security products stopped
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=7036} | Where-Object { $_.Message -match '(Defender|EDR|CrowdStrike|Sentinel|Carbon)' } | Select -First 10 TimeCreated,Message
# Service start type changed: 7040
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=7040} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Task registered: 106
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'; Id=106} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Task deleted: 141
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'; Id=141} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Task action executed: 200
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'; Id=200} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

commands.description: RDP EVENTS — 4778 (Session Reconnect) | 4779 (Session Disconnect) | 1149 (Auth OK — TermSvc-RemoteConn) | 21/22/23/24/25 (TermSvc-LocalSessionMgr)
commands.command:
# RDP session reconnect: 4778
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4778} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# RDP session disconnect: 4779
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4779} -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# RDP auth success (network level): 1149
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-RemoteConnectionManager/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=1149]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# RDP local session mgr (logon=21, logoff=23, reconnect=25, shadow=40):
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager/Operational' | Where-Object { $_.Id -in (21,23,24,25) } | Select TimeCreated,Id,Message | Select -First 20

commands.description: WINDOWS DEFENDER (WD) — 1116 (Malware Detected) | 1117 (Action Taken) | 1118 (Failed Action) | 5001 (RTP Disabled) | 5007 (Config Changed) | 5010 (Exclusion Added)
commands.command:
# Malware detected: 1116
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=1116]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Action taken on malware: 1117
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=1117]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# RTP disabled: 5001
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=5001]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message
# Config changed (exclusion added etc): 5007
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=5007]]' -MaxEvents 10 | Select TimeCreated,Message

rbcd_adcs_detection.description: PowerShell detection queries for RBCD setup (Event 5136), AD CS certificate abuse (Event 4887), and ADIDNS wildcard injection using Get-WinEvent.

commands.description: Detect msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute write (RBCD setup) — Event 5136
Detect machine account creation events (Event 4741 — prerequisite for RBCD via MAQ)
commands.command:
Get-WinEvent -ComputerName $DC -FilterHashtable @{
    LogName   = 'Security'
    Id        = 4741
    StartTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1)
} | Select-Object TimeCreated,
    @{N='NewAccount';E={$_.Properties[0].Value}},
    @{N='CreatedBy'; E={$_.Properties[4].Value}},
    @{N='SourceIP';  E={$_.Properties[18].Value}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

bec_m365_detection.description: PowerShell detection for Business Email Compromise — M365 inbox forwarding rules, suspicious OAuth consent grants, and account compromise indicators using Exchange Online / MSGraph.

commands.description: List all inbox rules with forwarding to external addresses (requires Exchange Online PS)
List all OAuth application consent grants with high-privilege permissions via MSGraph
Detect recently created inbox rules across all mailboxes (last 7 days)
commands.command:
# Requires Exchange Online admin
Search-UnifiedAuditLog -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) -EndDate (Get-Date) -Operations 'New-InboxRule','Set-InboxRule' -ResultSize 1000 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty AuditData | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object CreationTime, UserId, ClientIP, Parameters | Format-Table -AutoSize
